key_patterns: Player accuracy groups are computed by a shared buildGroup(group, rows, opts) engine. Football uses footballClassifier + a looser same-player pass rule; AFL passes aflClassify + an EMPTY loosePassPartKeys set (exact-match only). computePlayerAccuracyByScope(master,analyst,tol,name) canonicalises teams then runs computePlayerAccuracy per both/home/away scope and returns StoredPlayerAccuracy {football,both,home,away}. The grader gradeOverlapScoped (module-private in lib/api/accuracyChecks.ts) is the SINGLE derivation shared by save/update/propagate/backfill/merge: it canonicalises, scopes to overlap, grades, and computes player_accuracy. accuracy_checks row has sport column ('afl'|'football'|null) and player_accuracy JSON. The page reads STORED player_accuracy.both[key] via storedGroupPct; columns come from PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS (football keys). sportByCheck defaults a null sport to 'afl' for FILTERING, but legacy stored shapes may still be football — the per-row reader must detect the STORED shape, not the sport column. Item 7 (AFL shallow/deep collapse treated as exact) is already implemented in xml-compare.ts (depth-collapse in the canonical key) — no change needed.
